Invoke a documented Script API action

notes: get*() collection query functions are resolved during Script Console preflight and cached for backward compatibility; they do not dynamically re-evaluate after checkpoint.load or other state changes.
Use api query.runtime function=... for explicit execution-time state-sensitive inspection after in-script machine-state changes.
Bounded structured tuple iteration is supported with fixed-arity syntax such as for address,width in [(1002AE,16),(1002D8,16)] ... end; tuple rows are capped by the normal loop-iteration limit.
Tuple-list iteration is intentionally bounded data iteration, not a general object language.
